# External Integrations

#### Manage your external integrations with Doxis AI.dp.

The External Integrations page allows you to manage integrations with external services on the Doxis AI.dp platform. These integrations use the Doxis AI.dp API to access services, databases, and user data. This page lists the available external integrations.

### Doxis - CSB

![integrations_doxis](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/static/integrations_doxis-iAMLSHCH.png)

The Doxis - CSB integration connects to the Doxis Content Service Bus. This connection can be used in the following ways:

- **Model Builder**: [Create a model](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/model-builder/models/creation) with Doxis as data source. Synchronize documents with the Doxis environment and create datasets.
- **Flow Builder**: Use Doxis [components](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/flow-builder/components/doxis-csb) within the Flow Builder. The Flow Builder automatically retrieves connection details from the integrations page.

To create a Doxis - CSB connection, provide the following information:

- **Name**: A descriptive name to identify the connection.
- **URL**: The base URL of the Doxis instance. For example: https://klippa.exploredoxis.com.
- **Tenant**: The organization associated with the connection. A content service bus domain can have multiple organizations to separate environments or subject areas (e.g., development and production).
- **Username**: The username of an account with sufficient permissions to load documents.
- **Role**: The role assigned to the account.
- **Password Type**: The type of password. Options are "plain" and "encrypted".
- **Password**: The password value for the account.

### Doxis - ERPCS

The Doxis - ERPCS integration connects to the Doxis ERP Connection Service. This connection provides access to ERP master data - such as recipients, vendors, and purchase orders - which can be used for data matching during document capturing.

This integration is used by the [ERPCS Match](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/capturing/shared-components/data-matching/erpcs-match) component to look up ERP data at capture time.

To create a Doxis - ERPCS connection, provide the following information:

- **Name**: A descriptive name to identify the connection.
- **Version** (required): The API version used by the ERPCS instance. Options are `v1` (no authentication) and `v2` (with authentication, default).
- **API URL** (required): The base URL of the ERPCS API or cloud broker. For example: `https://your-erpcs-instance.exploredoxis.com/derpcs`.
- **Username**: Your ERPCS username. Required when using v2.
- **Password**: Your ERPCS password. Required when using v2.
- **System Name** (required): The name of the ERP system to connect to. Must match one of the systems registered in the ERPCS instance.
- **Cloud Broker Customer ID**: Optional customer ID for cloud broker environments.

### Large Language Model

The Large Language Model integration lets you bring your own AI provider. Prompts in the [Prompt Builder](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/prompt-builder) can then run on your own models instead of the platform managed model.

The following providers are supported:

- **OpenAI**
- **Azure OpenAI**
- **Anthropic**
- **OpenAI compatible endpoints**, for any other service that speaks the OpenAI API format

To set up the integration, provide the API key of your provider. The credentials are verified when you save, so a wrong key is caught immediately.

**Adding models**

Which models the integration offers depends on the provider. For Azure OpenAI and Anthropic, the list of models is fetched from the provider. For OpenAI and OpenAI compatible endpoints, you enter the model names yourself and test each one with a real document before saving. The test runs a small capture using your own credentials, which confirms the model name is valid and the model responds.

**Billing and errors**

Captures on your own models are billed the same as captures on the platform managed models. Problems on the provider side, such as a revoked key or an exhausted quota, surface as clear error messages on the capture.
